title: Support gap digest
summary: Each week, groups repeated support questions and flags the ones your help pages do not answer yet.

inspiration.title: RAG chatbot for company documents (Drive + Gemini)

stages.title: Read tickets
stages.does: Reads each ticket's question text and reference, with customer details removed.

stages.title: Group questions
stages.does: Groups questions by a normalised form and counts each group.

stages.title: Check the help pages
stages.does: Looks for an answer to each repeated question on the help pages.

stages.title: Learn
stages.does: Turns feedback on earlier runs into learning and proposals before the write.
stages.command: python3 skills/routineos/scripts/routineos.py learn --docs snapshot.json --run run.json --out learn

stages.title: Write
stages.does: Applies the run input under the write contract.
stages.command: python3 skills/routineos/scripts/routineos.py write --docs snapshot.json --run run.json --out batches

connectors.label: Help desk
connectors.purpose: Read the question text and reference of recent tickets.
alternatives: A JSON export of ticket texts placed in the run folder
connectors.connect: Add an MCP server or connector for your help desk with read access to tickets.

connectors.label: Web fetch
connectors.connect: Nothing to connect when the run can already open web pages.
